name: RobinWheelAndTweaks

description: Adds a secondary inventory wheel with a Lens of Truth after Ice Arrow, a Stone Mask, a Goron Mask, and a Giant's Mask, plus Shield Surf, Dark Link Form, Hover Boots, Magic Armor Twilight Ward, Rupee Magnet, Sit, Hawk Grass, Goron Tunic lava walking, and Hawk attack options.
